description: Striped rows in the Svelte 5 data grid with the zebraRows prop. Every other data row gets the theme's --sg-row-alt-bg background, while pinned, group, detail and summary rows keep their single background so a pinned totals row still reads as one solid band. The stripe colour is a theme token, so it follows whichever preset or dark mode the page uses.

faq.question: How do I stripe the rows?
faq.answer: Add zebraRows to <SvGrid>. No CSS is needed; the alternate rows use the --sg-row-alt-bg token of the active theme.

faq.question: How do I change the stripe colour?
faq.answer: Override --sg-row-alt-bg on the grid or its container. A subtle tint of the row background is what the built-in presets use.

faq.question: Why are group and summary rows not striped?
faq.answer: Striping only applies to data rows. Group headers, detail panels, pinned rows and summary rows keep their own background so they stay visually distinct.
